stories.title: Felony charges dropped against Jacksonville woman accused of intentionally running over ducklings
stories.summary: Beverly Sasberry, who was arrested after allegedly repeatedly driving through a group of ducklings and killing 11, now faces misdemeanor animal cruelty charges.

stories.title: Raising Cane's opening second Jacksonville location in Town Center Nov. 23
stories.summary: The restaurant is planning opening day festivities, including a drawing for 20 customers to win free free Raising Cane's for a year.

stories.title: Dream job for Florida State's Jeff Purinton starts with fixing football
stories.summary: Palatka native, Jeff Purinton is welcomed to his dream job as FSU’s new vice president and director of athletics.

stories.title: Group walks across Fuller Warren Bridge to honor people killed in car crashes on World Day of Remembrance
stories.summary: A few dozen people carried posters and flowers across the bridge to bring attention to the amount of people killed on Jacksonville roads each year.

stories.title: 61-year-old woman reported missing out of Jacksonville found safe
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Sheriff's Office says Brenda Johnson has been found safe.

stories.title: Crash into fire hydrant causes washout off of Moncrief Road: JEA
stories.summary: A car at the entrance of Strawflower Place appeared to be sinking into the flooded ground Sunday night while JEA crews worked.

stories.title: Police activity near Glen Gardner Drive in Jacksonville
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Sheriff's Office tells First Coast news that officers are investigating an undetermined death near Glen Gardner Drive.

stories.title: Man injured in Norwood Avenue shooting: JSO
stories.summary: A man in his late teens was injured in a shooting on Norwood Avenue on Sunday morning, according to the Jacksonville Sheriff's Office.

stories.title: Anglers push to 'reel in' funding to restore George Crady Bridge Fishing Pier
stories.summary: The "bridge crew" wore neon green shirts to the Duval legislative delegation meeting to ask state lawmakers for help to reopen the Duval side of the bridge.

stories.title: JSO: Man treated for non-life-threatening injuries after shooting on San Jose Blvd; suspect unknown
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Sheriff's Office says that the suspect tied to the shooting is currently unknown.

stories.title: Jacksonville man killed in crash: FHP
stories.summary: The Florida Highway Patrol says the crash occurred on State Road 9B northbound, near North E-Town Parkway.

stories.title: FAA ground stop leaves travelers dealing with delays and cancellations at Jacksonville International Airport
stories.summary: A nationwide FAA ground stop disrupted flights, whihc caused delays for passengers with extended journeys, at Jacksonville International Airport.
